Let $R \subseteq A \times B$ be such that:
\begin{enumerate}
\item If $Rxy$ and $Rxz$ then $y = z$; and 
\item for every $x \in A$ there is some $y \in B$ such that $\tuple{x,
y} \in R$.  
\end{enumerate}
Then $R$ is the graph of the function $f\colon A \to B$ defined by
$f(x) = y$ iff $Rxy$.
